# Lenient typed answers

<!-- Generated by scripts/answer_rules_table.js (npm run docs:rules). Do not edit by hand. -->

What each word accepts in the quiz's typed questions, beyond the exact textbook answer. Extra answers come from three places: words in the same topic with the identical English meaning, the teacher's per-word list (`ALSO_ACCEPTED` in `scripts/import_vocab.py`), and rules turned on per topic in `site/js/answer-rules.js`. Topics not listed here are graded exactly. Multiple choice is never affected.

## School 学校 (`school`)

Rules: `xue-suffix`

### Also accepts other answers

| Word | English | Also accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 心理学 | psychology | 心理, 心理科学 |
| 代数学 | algebra | 代数, 代数科学 |
| 几何学 | geometry | 几何, 几何科学 |
| 统计学 | statistics | 统计, 统计科学 |
| 生物学 | biology | 生物, 生物科学 |
| 物理学 | physics | 物理, 物理科学 |
| 环境科学 | environmental science | 环境学 |
| 解剖学 | anatomy | 解剖, 解剖科学 |
| 生理学 | physiology | 生理, 生理科学 |
| 计算机学 | computer science | 计算机, 计算机科学 |

### Exact only: the rule deliberately doesn't apply

| Word | English | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 世界文学 | world literature | 文学 means "literature", so its 学 isn't an "-ology" ending |
| 英国文学 | English literature | 文学 means "literature", so its 学 isn't an "-ology" ending |
| 经济学 | economics | excluded by the teacher |
| 社会学 | sociology | excluded by the teacher |
| 数学 | mathematics | too short: fewer than 2 characters would be left |
| 科学 | science | too short: fewer than 2 characters would be left |
| 化学 | chemistry | too short: fewer than 2 characters would be left |
| 医学 | medicine | too short: fewer than 2 characters would be left |

All other School 学校 words are graded exactly.
